reason: The README clearly describes a DSH chat plugin for displaying uploaded images and obtaining visual descriptions through configurable cloud or local multimodal models.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 聊天界面中显示用户上传的图片，并通过云端或本地视觉模型进行图像解读。
summaries.en: Displays user-uploaded images in the DSH chat interface and analyzes them with configurable cloud or local vision models.

capabilities: renders uploaded PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF images in the chat interface
stores uploaded images as session attachments
analyzes session attachments or local image files through a visual_review tool
can send image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible multimodal API
can run a local Python worker with a Qwen3-VL model for image analysis
reads and updates cloud endpoint, API key, and model configuration
